rows.destination: Source clip regions
rows.limitations: Confirmed deckTransport uses audible time. Legacy requested times and opening DSP state are not exact.

rows.destination: Clips referencing retained source assets
rows.limitations: Sources must remain available. Changing sources during replay still requires real-time dispatch.

rows.destination: Repeated source regions and loop metadata
rows.limitations: Tiny fragments and expansion limits require the print; live effect history across loops is not fully reconstructed.

rows.destination: Clip playback rate
rows.limitations: Rate is represented, not a project tempo map. Key-locked and pitch-processed audio still needs the print.

rows.action: Beat sync / project tempo / tempo-map follow
rows.destination: Re-derived clip playback rates
rows.limitations: Sync intent is journaled, not each correction. Replay re-runs the live controller; Arrange approximates its slews as constant-rate regions within 0.1%.

rows.action: Deck / stem pitch and key lock
rows.destination: Replay event controls; printed sound in Arrange
rows.limitations: Fixed-source replay has compiled pitch commands; no equivalent editable arrangement pitch reconstruction.

rows.destination: Combined lane volume automation
rows.limitations: Individual controls are folded into a single volume envelope; full live/export parity remains unqualified.

rows.destination: Combined lane volume automation
rows.limitations: Stem mix is editable as volume, not independent original control lanes. Lane FX remain printed.

rows.destination: Replay event controls; printed EQ in Arrange
rows.limitations: Recorded EQ is not converted to arrangement devices or envelopes.

rows.destination: Replay event controls; printed filter in Arrange
rows.limitations: Stable filter types can schedule replay sweeps; arrangement reconstruction does not create their automation.

rows.destination: Replay event controls; printed effects in Arrange
rows.limitations: Opening tails, legacy effects and DSP graph changes are not certified exact.

rows.destination: Replay event controls; printed returns and inserts in Arrange
rows.limitations: Headphone cue is monitoring only and is never recorded. Reconstructed sources use the current return settings.

rows.destination: Replay event controls; printed master processing
rows.limitations: Reconstructed sources use the current master settings, not a reconstructed historical master chain.

rows.destination: Printed pad recording; optional event rebuild
rows.limitations: Rebuilt synthesized noise can differ from the captured sound.

rows.destination: Aligned captured input; versioned processing replay
rows.limitations: Editable processing requires version-1 input capture and its dry lane. Legacy inputs remain printed.

rows.destination: Recorded input intervals plus history
rows.limitations: Device changes are not recreated. Unarmed, unmonitored input cannot be recovered.

rows.destination: MIDI clips via the arrangement recorder
rows.limitations: Separate MIDI recording path; full live-performance-to-MIDI lifecycle still needs qualification.

rows.destination: Authored arrangement pan envelopes; live history not reconstructed
rows.limitations: Arrangement pan is available, but no qualified captured live-pan lifecycle exists.

rows.destination: Printed sound and local device configuration
rows.limitations: Physical device and cue topology are not reconstructed. Printed output preserves only the signal actually captured.

rows.destination: Track/device envelopes
rows.limitations: Authored arrangement envelopes exist; this does not imply conversion of every live FX mutation.
